name: glob_files
description: Find files and directories by glob pattern inside registered source directories using a safe ripgrep-style traversal that respects source scope, hidden-file settings, and gitignore files. Use this when you need to locate candidate paths before reading, searching, or editing.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match, such as *.md, notes/**/*.txt, or **/README.*

patterns.description: Optional multiple glob patterns. Overrides pattern when provided.

path.description: Optional directory to search. If omitted, searches all directories in the current source scope.

include_hidden.description: Include dotfiles and hidden directories (default false)

include_dirs.description: Include matching directories as well as files (default false)

max_results.description: Maximum number of paths to return (default 100, max 500)
